statement: 적벽 데모 고속정 전대의 편성·임무장비·비용 규칙이다. 수량과 비용은 역사적 사실이 아닌 normal-demo 밸런스 값이다.

category_contract.distinction: 고속정은 임무장비 1종을 탑재하는 소형 전투정이고, 요격함은 독립 고속 전투함이다. 두 함종의 재고와 비용은 합산하지 않는다.

tactical_mission_contract: equipment is immutable after battle initialization; mission changes only select an allowlisted tactical intent; rescue is consumed by G6-05 while other mission effects remain pending

supply_contract.inventory_contract: normal-demo source capacity and G6-06 integrated supply-ship inventory jointly authorize full atomic refill

supply_inventory_contract.throughput_credit_policy: at each turn boundary carry only credit modulo 10000, then add the current weighted rate; unused integer slots never accumulate
supply_inventory_contract.refill_policy: full_refill_only_atomic; insufficient candidate waits and the next deterministic candidate may be considered
supply_inventory_contract.debit_policy: fuel=actual fuel granted; ammo=actual G4 ammo plus special granted; supply_materials=1 per completed squadron
supply_inventory_contract.reload_policy: same-faction friendly base only; provider remains stationary for one full turn; reload occurs after outbound supply and is usable next turn
supply_inventory_contract.destruction_policy: for d newly destroyed among N previously non-destroyed ships, each remaining stock becomes floor(before*(N-d)/N)
supply_inventory_contract.capture_policy: remaining stock becomes zero immediately; captor gain is zero; source remains disabled for the battle
supply_inventory_contract.damage_authority: G8-00 only; authoritative reducers accept current-turn intents only before resolution completes; actual G8 resolver triggers remain deferred

basing_contract.carrier: 강습모함 탑재형 준비 metadata; 실제 전투 중 출격·재보급은 G6-03 이후
basing_contract.base: 우주기지·행성 거점 배치형 준비 metadata; 실제 자동 보급은 G6-03 이후

inventory_policy: applied setup faction inventory minus all setup squadron assignments; preparation may create or delete user fast-craft squadrons from remaining same-faction stock; cross-faction transfer forbidden
cost_policy: per craft subtotal=(setup SHP-08 base unit cost+selected setup mission-equipment unit cost)*count; historical cost is the declared normal-demo baseline
